questions.question:
Select the most appropriate answer from the options given below regarding Census 2011.

Statement 1. The population of India has increased by more than 181 million during the decade 2001-2011.

Statement 2. The percentage decadal growth during 2001-2011 has registered the sharpest decline since Independence.
questions.option_2: Both statements 1 and 2 are not correct.

questions.question: The rotating columns of air that occur over water bodies and are generally less severe than land tornadoes are known as:
Which Indian city experiences the LEAST difference in average temperature between its hottest and coldest months?
Which letter code indicates mid-latitude desert climate in Köppen climate classification?
Which international treaty was adopted in 1992 to combat global warming and prepare for its effects?
questions.option_1: Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants
questions.option_3: Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer
questions.option_4: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
